title: Smart Tooltip Scroll
description: Dynamically resizes and scrolls oversized tooltips while keeping the item title anchored.
body:
# Smart Tooltip Scroll

**Smart Tooltip Scroll (STS)** introduces clean, customizable, and scrollable tooltips, all in one stop.

---

## 🌟 Key Features

*   **Scrollable Tooltips:** Easily navigate through massive tooltips containing extensive lore, stats, or enchantments using your mouse wheel.
*   **Resizable Tooltips:** Customize and restrict the width and height bounds of tooltips. Adjusts to GUI size and screen resolution perfectly.
*   **Pinned Headers:** The item name and header remain pinned at the very top of the tooltip while you scroll through the description. You'll never lose track of what item you are inspecting!
*   **Smooth Scrolling:** The tooltip smoothly glides on your screen while you're scrolling it.

---

## 🔌 Compatibility

STS is built with compatibility in mind. Currently compatible mods:

*   **Legendary Tooltips:** Works flawlessly out of the box, preserving the border aesthetics and styles of Legendary Tooltips while enabling scrolling.
*   **Tierify Integration (First of its kind!):** The *only* scroll mod that fully integrates with Tierify, seamlessly injecting Legendary Tooltips components directly into Tierify's custom rendering without breaking the UI.

If there's any mod that breaks functionality, request it and it will be added

---

### 📦 Dependencies
*   Requires [S-Lib](https://modrinth.com/mod/s-lib) to run.
